mapper.select: SELECT EVENT_ID AS eventId, COMPANY_NAME AS companyName, EVENT_TITLE AS eventTitle, MAX_PARTICIPANTS AS maxParticipants, CURRENT_PARTICIPANTS AS currentParticipants, ROUND((CURRENT_PARTICIPANTS / MAX_PARTICIPANTS) * 100, 2) AS participationRate FROM CL_EVENT WHERE EVENT_ID = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CL_EVENT_PARTICIPANT (PARTICIPANT_ID, EVENT_ID, MEMBER_NO) VALUES (CL_EVENT_PARTICIPANT_SEQ.NEXTVAL, #{eventId}, #{memberNo})
mapper.update: UPDATE CL_EVENT SET CURRENT_PARTICIPANTS = CURRENT_PARTICIPANTS + 1 WHERE EVENT_ID = #{eventId} AND CURRENT_PARTICIPANTS < MAX_PARTICIPANTS
